meta.name: customer-journey-mapping-workshop
meta.description: Run a customer journey mapping workshop with adaptive questions and outputs. Use when you need to map stages, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for a persona and scenario.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导用户绘制客户旅程地图，发现痛点与机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统梳理用户与产品的交互全流程
copy.tagline_en: Guide users to map customer journeys, uncover pain points and opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically map user interactions with your product

howto.what: 引导你完成客户旅程地图的创建。它会依次询问角色、场景、阶段、行动/情绪和机会，最终输出一张包含痛点与改进机会的旅程图。
howto.when: 当你需要为一个特定角色和场景绘制端到端的客户体验地图，并识别痛点与改进机会时触发。

say.text: 帮我为新手房东的首次出租流程做一次旅程地图工作坊。
say.note: 启动工作坊，Claude 会逐步引导你完成地图。

say.text: 为从试用注册到首次体验价值的买家绘制旅程地图。
say.note: 直接指定场景，Claude 会据此生成阶段和内容。

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating a customer journey map. It asks adaptive questions about persona, scenario, phases, actions/emotions, and opportunities, then outputs a map with pain points and improvement ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to map the end-to-end customer experience for a specific persona and scenario, identifying pain points and opportunities.

say_en.text: Run a journey mapping workshop for a first-time landlord listing their first property.
say_en.note: Starts the workshop; Claude will guide step by step.

say_en.text: Map the experience of a buyer from trial signup to first value.
say_en.note: Directly specifies the scenario for the map.
